name: Taylorcraft BC / Model A / L-2
summary: Light side-by-side two-seat tube-and-fabric high-wing taildragger from Alliance, Ohio; hugely numerous prewar, wartime as the L-2 spotter, and postwar as the BC-12D.

wings: High wing braced by a steel-tube strut each side
Straight, tapered wing with rounded tips
engines: Single small flat-four, cowled around the cylinders
Two-blade fixed-pitch wooden or metal propeller
fuselage: Side-by-side two-seat cabin with a large, upright windshield
Fabric-covered tube fuselage tapering to the tail
Fixed main gear with a tailwheel
tail: Rounded fin and rudder on a conventional horizontal tail

tellTales: Two-seat side-by-side cabin under a strut-braced high wing
Tube-and-fabric taildragger with a tapering rear fuselage
Rounded Cub-like tail on a very small high-wing

confusedWith.howToTell: The Taylorcraft seats two side by side; the Champ is a tandem two-seater with a long, narrow cabin.
The Taylorcraft has side-by-side seats in a wider cabin; the Cub's seats are in tandem under a narrow roof.
Both are side-by-side tube-and-fabric high-wings; the Taylorcraft's fuselage is narrower and more angular, whereas the Chief's cabin is deeper and rounder.
The Taylorcraft is fabric-covered with a straight single strut; the Luscombe is all-metal with a V-strut and a smoother, polished skin.
